classes.name: Player
classes.description: A tenant who owns planets and fleets.

classes.name: Planet
classes.description: An owned world. Hidden from other tenants unless allied or cleared.

classes.name: Fleet
classes.description: Parked or in-flight ships.

classes.name: Faction
classes.description: An NPC diplomatic counterpart.

classes.name: Outpost
classes.description: A pirate or contested world.

classes.name: Marking
classes.description: Classification and compartments on a fact, plan, report or law.

classes.name: Compartment
classes.description: A need-to-know label that a clearance must include.

classes.name: Clearance
classes.description: Highest classification and compartments a role or leader may see.

classes.name: SharingAgreement
classes.description: Allied-faction access to marked objects at a stated class and compartment set.

classes.name: Region
classes.description: A market venue keyed by a star-system coordinate.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Per-region inventory for a trader.

classes.name: Good
classes.description: A traded resource priced in metal.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A limit or market bid or ask on a regional book.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: A delivery or procurement agreement with a deadline and penalty.

classes.name: Trader
classes.description: The player or an NPC counterparty on the regional market.

classes.name: Shipment
classes.description: Goods in transit between regions. Pays fuel and takes flight time.

classes.name: Treasury
classes.description: Empire cash account. Income and expenses are valued materials, energy and labour.

classes.name: Budget
classes.description: A period spending cap on a cost center, with forecast and actual.

classes.name: CostCenter
classes.description: A department, fleet or colony that spending is charged to.

classes.name: Expense
classes.description: A valued spend of materials, energy or labour in the current period.

classes.name: Forecast
classes.description: Expected spend from queued work and held approvals.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: A decision that releases a held spend over a budget or role limit.

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: A named series computed from live production, energy, waste, treasury, incidents, missions or trade.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: A goal value on a KPI owned by the empire, a colony or a role.

classes.name: Measurement
classes.description: A period sample of a KPI with variance versus its target and source event ids.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: An archived period of KPI measurements, highlights and pending decisions.

classes.name: Incident
classes.description: A structured lifecycle for a raid, failure, shortage, accident or contract miss.

classes.name: Risk
classes.description: A known threat with likelihood, impact and a review date.

classes.name: Resolution
classes.description: The closing action and note on an incident.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: A post-incident archive with timeline, root cause and follow-ups.

classes.name: FollowUp
classes.description: A recommended law, maintenance or fleet change from a review.

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: A building, defence battery or vehicle whose condition is tracked.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Health of an asset from use, age and heat, from 1.0 (new) to worn.

classes.name: MaintenancePlan
classes.description: A time-based or usage-based service interval for an asset.

classes.name: WorkOrder
classes.description: Scheduled service or repair that takes an asset offline for a cost.

classes.name: TelemetryReading
classes.description: A noisy sample of temperature, vibration and power for an asset.

classes.name: FailurePrediction
classes.description: Chance an asset fails within the configured horizon, from the hourly bathtub rate.

relations.name: owns
relations.description: The player who holds the planet.

relations.name: placed-in
relations.description: The book that holds the order.

relations.name: binds
relations.description: The holder who accepted the contract.

relations.name: fulfils
relations.description: A shipment that delivers against an accepted contract.

relations.name: charged-to
relations.description: The department, fleet or colony that bears the spend.

relations.name: approved-by
relations.description: The player or assigned leader who released a held spend.

relations.name: compared-with
relations.description: The goal a measurement is scored against.

relations.name: owned-by
relations.description: A colony or role that holds a KPI target. Empire targets have no planet owner.

relations.name: generated-from
relations.description: The samples archived into a periodic report.

relations.name: affects
relations.description: Objects named on an open incident.

relations.name: assigned-to
relations.description: The leader who owns the incident.

relations.name: caused-by
relations.description: History events that opened or explain the incident.

relations.name: closed-by
relations.description: The resolution that closed the incident.

relations.name: reviewed-in
relations.description: The post-incident review archived for a serious case.
